title: Mapping Memes to Words for Multimodal Hateful Meme Classification
findings: The proposed model, ISSUES, achieves state-of-the-art performance on the Hateful Memes Challenge (HMC) dataset. This dataset includes memes where the hateful content is aimed at religion, among other categories like race and sex. The paper does not provide a breakdown of performance specifically on religious content versus other categories.
